hero.title: We build brands that win trust - and keep them growing.
hero.lead: Redbarn Ventures is a global brand, digital and growth agency, established in 2023. We advise, design, build and market for ambitious companies - one senior team, one point of contact, no hand-offs.

items.d: Logo, colour, type and usage rules

statement.title: Most companies juggle a designer, a developer, an agency and a consultant. We are all four - and we talk to each other.

points.d: You explain your business once. Every specialist works from the same page.
Brand, website and marketing are planned together, so nothing contradicts anything else.
A senior lead owns your account and answers your messages - from first call to year three.

build.d: Logos and identity systems with clear rules, so every person and supplier uses your brand the same way.
Fast, search-ready company and marketing sites, built so your own team can edit pages without a developer.
Online stores with clean product pages, Shopping feeds and the tracking you need to see what actually sells.
Screens, flows and design systems for iOS and web apps, ready for your developers to build from.
Decks that tell a clear story in the room and survive being forwarded - on your own editable template.
Monthly SEO, AI-search, content and LinkedIn work that compounds - reported in plain language.

trust.d: The people you meet are the people who do the work. No juniors learning on your budget.
You get a written plan, timeline and quote before any work begins. No surprise invoices.
Source files, logins, domains and code are yours from day one - nothing held back.
Websites, decks and templates are set up so your own people can update them confidently.
If something will not help your business, we say so - even when it means less work for us.
Ongoing design, website care and marketing, so your brand keeps improving instead of ageing.

process.d: A focused conversation about your business, your customers and what is not working today. No preparation needed on your side.
Within days you receive a written plan: what we will make, in what order, by when and for how much.
We work in short rounds you can see and steer. You review real work, not slides about work.
We launch, hand over everything, train your team - and keep improving it month after month if you want us to.

engage.d: A defined piece of work with a fixed quote and a clear finish line.
points: Written plan and quote up front

engage.d: A monthly team for brands that need steady design, web and marketing support.
Senior advice for a launch, a new market or a stalled growth plan.

faq.q: What kind of companies do you work with?
faq.a: Established businesses and ambitious new ventures around the world that want to look and sell like leaders in their field - from industrial and energy companies to consumer brands, software products and professional services. If you care about quality and want a long-term partner, we are likely a good fit.

faq.q: Can you handle our brand, website, marketing and AI together?
faq.a: Yes, that is what we are built for. One senior agency team plans and delivers your brand, website, marketing, sales material and AI automations together, so everything works as one system instead of separate projects.

faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: It depends on scope. A focused company site is usually a matter of weeks; larger builds with many pages, languages or a store take longer. You get an exact timeline in your written plan before we start.

faq.q: Do we own the files and the website?
faq.a: Always. Source files, code, domains and accounts belong to you from day one. We set everything up in your name and document it, so you are never locked in.

faq.q: Do you offer support after launch?
faq.a: Yes. You can keep us on an ongoing partnership for website care, new design work, SEO and content - or simply call on us whenever you need something.

faq.q: Which platforms do you build on?
faq.a: We choose the platform that fits your team: modern static sites for speed, WordPress and Elementor when your team wants to edit visually, WooCommerce or Shopify for stores, and native designs for iOS apps.
Send us an email or use the contact form with a few lines about your business and what you need. We will arrange a short call and follow up with a written plan and quote.
